title: Non-Archimedean Bedford–Taylor Theory

presentation.scope: Six primary sections are Overview, Conjectures, Progress, Complex comparison, Plan and Papers. Progress synthesizes six principal parts of the theory; all 74 original records remain in a searchable catalogue with their stable routes. Overview and Conjectures supply explicit source-backed definitions and precise article links. This unsigned reading edition omits personal bylines and metadata, and places existing mathematical question marks over the relation in question. Frozen originals remain in the private project history; served reading copies have their own byte hashes. Mathematical statements, proof status and permanent links are preserved.
